propositions: ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability detection against @runtime_checkable Protocols, which is correct on Python 3.11 but unsafe on Python 3.12+ due to getattr_static behavior change (gh-102433)

CPython 3.12+ uses inspect.getattr_static for isinstance checks on @runtime_checkable Protocols, which does not see attributes served by __getattr__, causing dynamically-proxying objects to fail the check despite having the capability
The single executable isinstance-against-Protocol capability dispatch in dispatch_apply_phases.py:188 is already hardened with an or hasattr fallback, making it proxy-safe
A tree-wide sweep confirms no other unsafe isinstance-against-Supports* Protocol sites exist in src/rebar; all adjacent capability checks use hasattr which is proxy-safe

ADR-0083 text must be amended to document that isinstance is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+, prescribing the isinstance-primary plus member-hasattr-fallback pattern, with _capability_present as the reference implementation
